uncertain: No boys state titles, runner-ups or semifinal appearances: absent from the MHSAA past champions page, and michigan-football.com lists 0 state titles through 2015. The best finish found is the 1960-61 quarterfinal. Seasons after 2014-15 are not verified.

michigan-football.com's summary reads D8:R1:S0, but its table marks only 7 district title seasons. The one marked regional title (1961) may be counted among the 8 districts, or a district title is missing.

Do not confuse this school with Fowler (Class D champion 1951-52), which appears on the MHSAA past champions page.
